d:
Following his blockbuster trade to the Montreal Canadiens, relive some of the most spectacular plays from Dylan Larkin's 11 seasons in Detroit. From blazing speed and incredible individual efforts to highlight-reel goals and beautiful setups, enjoy the very best of the former Red Wings captain.
Selected 15th overall in the 2014 NHL Draft, Larkin recorded 278 goals and 371 assists for 649 points in 818 regular-season games with Detroit before being traded to Montreal on November 22, 2026.
Which Dylan Larkin highlight is your favorite? Let us know in the comments!
